notes: CRATE LOCKS: crack 3 locks by tapping when the needle hits a colour - blue = Rare, purple = Epic, gold = Legendary, dead centre = PERFECT. Hit all 3 (with a purple or gold) for a JACKPOT extra card
THE HORDE: hundreds of creatures now lurk in the dark around you, and it grows every threat level
SURGES: the horde masses on one side and charges - watch for the red arrows
Rarity is now earned more through the locks than luck (can be turned off in Options)
